articles.title: There is no vacuum at Defence Ministry -Brogya Genfi
articles.summary: Deputy Minister for Defence, Ernest Brogya Genfi, addressed concerns, stating definitively that there is no leadership vacuum within the Ministry of Defence. Speaking on the Channel One Newsroom programme, Genfi reassured the public and military personnel. This statement aims to quash any speculation regarding the ministry's stability and command structure, reinforcing confidence in its operational continuity.

articles.title: Hardik Pandya 5.0: Intense grind behind beast mode, close interactions with coach, redemption
articles.summary: Masked gangs targeted Indian shops, restaurants, and stores in Wembley, London, causing alarm. This incident raises significant concerns regarding the safety and security of Indian-owned businesses and the diaspora community abroad. It underscores the need for robust protective measures by local authorities and could warrant diplomatic engagement to ensure the well-being of Indian citizens and their establishments.

articles.title: Church urges Maharashtra govt to reconsider cabinet nod to anti-conversion Bill
articles.summary: Union Minister Giriraj Singh controversially labeled Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi an "Urban Naxal," escalating political rhetoric. Simultaneously, Dimple Yadav criticized the government over surging gas prices, alleging India's foreign policy was influenced by the US. These statements reflect ongoing domestic political discourse and economic concerns, highlighting key national issues for aspirants to understand.
